scenes.en: Do's and don'ts for kids' frames.
scenes.ta: குழந்தைகளுக்குச் சரியான ஃப்ரேம் எப்படித் தேர்வு செய்வது?
scenes.say: Kids drop, bend and sit on their glasses. Here's how to pick frames that survive.

scenes.en: TR90 frames bend without snapping and stay light.
scenes.say: Do pick flexible frames, like TR90. They bend without snapping, and stay light on a small nose.

scenes.en: Eyes centred in the lenses. Frame no wider than the face.
scenes.say: Do get the right size. Eyes in the centre of the lenses, and a frame no wider than the face.

scenes.big: DON'T: Buy big to grow into
scenes.en: Loose frames slide down and kids peek over the top.
scenes.say: Don't buy a big frame to grow into. Loose frames slide down, and kids peek over the top.

scenes.en: Studies link more outdoor play with less short-sightedness in kids.
scenes.say: Did you know? Studies show more outdoor play is linked to less short-sightedness in children.
